sloka: रामास्त्रविद्धो घोरं वै नदन् राक्षसपुङ्गवः।अभ्यधावत सङ्क्रुद्धो हरीन् विद्रावयन् रणे ।। ६.६७.१०७ ।।
transliteration: rāmāstraviddho ghoraṁ vai nadan rākṣasapuṅgavaḥ।abhyadhāvata saṅkruddho harīn vidrāvayan raṇe ।। 6.67.107 ।।

translations.english: Thereupon the Rakshasa sounding like the rumblings of clouds disdainfully spoke these words to Lakshmana, the son of Sumitra.
